sim_2025_scirep.note: The pump and seed sizes are 530 and 330 um, 1/e^2 intensity radii. Gain about 16 uses the 10 uW gain-scan seed. Gain about 15 is reported for the 8 uW squeezing point. The old 15.5 midpoint is not a measured gain. The rounded 111 and 109 uW powers give 13.875 and 13.625 relative to 8 uW, respectively.

sim_2025_scirep.locator: PDF pp. 4-5, Fig. 3 and loss paragraph
sim_2025_scirep.note: Direct IDS is -7.8 dB. Power-slope IDS is 0.134 (about -8.7 dB), with its own conditions. The authors report 5.5(2)% optical and 8.0(2)% detection-system losses, with 13.5(2)% total. The historical product of 0.945 and 0.92 is a different calculation from their total efficiency of 0.865.

mccormick_2007_ol.locator: PDF pp. 1-2 (178-179), Brewster cell, Figs. 2-3 and loss correction
mccormick_2007_ol.note: The final optical path is about 9 mm, superseding the unsupported 19 mm legacy value. The setup maximum 200 uW is not the Fig. 2 optimum seed. Post-medium 80% optics and 82% detector QE give a derived 65.6% external efficiency, separate from 7% in-cell probe absorption. Direct IDS and fitted slope are each -3.5 dB. The authors loss-correct to -8.1 dB.

mccormick_2007_ol.note: The preprint gives about 8 mm. Keep this as a version discrepancy.

mccormick_2008_pra.locator: PDF pp. 2-4, Fig. 2, effective-gain definition and Fig. 4
mccormick_2008_pra.note: Effective gain includes a window correction. The inferred intrinsic gain range 9-15 is a different quantity. The 305 and 290 uW powers belong to the low-frequency Fig. 4 condition, not the 100 uW nominal-gain measurement. The paper gives 95.5(2.0)% optical-path transmission and 94.5(2.0)% photodiode efficiency, combining them as 90(3)% total detection efficiency.

vogl_2012_spie.locator: PDF pp. 1-3, setup, Sec. 3 and Figs. 1-2
vogl_2012_spie.note: The body describes blue seeding. The schematic appears to show the opposite branch, so no signed GABES delta is assigned. Reported gain is a range 4-10. Its midpoint 7 is not a measured gain. Fig. 2 labels zero span at 800 kHz while the text says 800 MHz.

liu_2011_ol.note: The 400 mW noise run is separate from the 100-700 mW bandwidth sweep with about 5.5-16.5 MHz endpoints. Approximate 80/70 uW outputs and 10 uW seed yield derived 8/7 ratios. The 96% detector QE and 90% pump-off probe transmission describe different planes.

wu_2019_oe.locator: PDF pp. 3-4, setup and Figs. 2-3 captions
wu_2019_oe.note: Fig. 2 reports output 129 uW for a 6.4 uW seed and 17 uW for a 0.9 uW seed, each with gain about 20 and pump 420 mW. These are separate single-seed runs. The caption does not identify the output arm or reference plane. Fig. 3 is a 750 mW dual-seed run. Detector QE is 95%.
unresolved: Fig. 2 output arm and power reference plane

dearaujo_2024_oe.note: Vacuum-seeded homodyne quadrature belongs to a different measurement class from seeded direct IDS. Approximately 800 mW pump before splitting gives approximately 400 mW per arm. The sub-Hz result with electronic-noise subtraction is a separate condition.

allen_2026_oe.note: The Fig. 3 direct result is -8.2 dB at 218 uW conjugate output and 12 uW input seed. The ratio 218/12 is not probe gain. The Fig. 3 slope ratio is 0.131 (about -8.8 dB). The retuned five-hour mean is a separate stability measurement.
unresolved: probe gain and 1/e^2 radii at the measured optimum

jain_2025_ol.note: Direct measured IDS is -7.2 dB before fiber and -4.4 dB after fiber. The authors cite coupling above 90% and expect -6.3 dB for 10% loss. Applying symmetric vacuum loss at exactly 10% to -7.2 dB gives -5.66244 dB, recorded separately from both the reported expectation and the measurements.
unresolved: quantitative contribution of the author-proposed mode-mismatch mechanisms

monsa_2026_preprint.locator: v1 PDF pp. 1, 7-9, abstract and Figs. 5-6
monsa_2026_preprint.note: Fig. 5 gives about -8 dB over 40-500 kHz, approximate gain 15 and detected 150/120 uW powers. The abstract labels about -8 dB at 0.8 MHz separately. Fig. 6 gives slope ratio 0.135 near 1 MHz and describes about -8 dB. The same ratio converts to -8.696662 dB. Retain the stated and converted values separately.

historical_gold_fits.note: Single nominal gain target. Conjugate gain and conditional noise are model outputs.
Two rounded output-power targets with known seed. Their normalized gains are arithmetic ratios. The observed -7.8 dB is a comparison and does not enter the fit.
